segments.text: Hi, I'm Dev. I'm a video editor, graphic designer, AI generalist, social media manager and prompt engineer.
I love transforming ideas into powerful visual experiences.
From cinematic video editing and motion graphics to creative branding, photography and AI-powered content, I bring ideas to life through visual storytelling.
Take a look around my studio and explore some of my work.
And when you find something you like, let's create something extraordinary together.

bio.lead: Eight years of crafting visual stories that elevate brands, public figures, and agencies through precision editing, motion design, photography, and AI-powered creative production.
paragraphs: Based in Jaipur, Rajasthan and collaborating worldwide, I direct productions across the complete creative lifecycle — from concept, lighting, and camera direction on set to editorial pacing, colour grading, sound design, and After Effects motion compositing in the suite.

Across 500+ delivered projects and 100+ client shoots, my work spans commercial brand films, high-retention social reels, broadcast interviews and podcasts at Mahanagar Times News Agency, public-figure campaign storytelling including Civil Lines MLA Dr. Gopal Sharma, and next-generation AI visual narratives built through deliberate prompt engineering.
Every frame, graphic composition, and motion cue is built around a single standard: clarity of story and measurable audience engagement.
